actor.description: The original grantor: must equal the actor that signed the grant being revoked.

subject.description: Internal reference of the revoked grant: 'statement:<grant-statement-id>'. Must agree with body.revoked_grant.

revoked_grant.description: StatementId of the ActorCapabilityGrant being revoked.

retroactive.description: If true, invalidates the grant from inception (every statement issued under it is re-evaluated). Default revocation only invalidates statements created strictly after this revocation.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason. Included in canonical bytes.
